_comment: Machine-specific paths for this checkout. Regenerate with scripts/sync-env.ps1 -Refresh; everything else is derived from here. Only what pixi cannot supply lives here: cmake, ninja, clangd and - on Linux - the CUDA toolkit and gcc come from pixi.toml, and the GPU architecture from CMake's native detection. vcpkg.root is optional and falls back to the VCPKG_ROOT environment variable.
